name: shiyi
description: 拾忆 —— 个人影像管理与智能检索平台

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:web && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix api run db:generate && npm --prefix api run db:push
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:webapi: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai && set MOCK_AI=0 && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:ai:mock: cd ai && set MOCK_AI=1 && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck
